name: ascii-diagram-helper
description: Rust-based ASCII and Unicode diagram tool for Pi AI agent harness

scripts.prepare: command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run build || echo 'ascii-diagram: cargo not found — run "cargo build --release" manually or install the binary to ~/.local/bin'
scripts.build: cargo build --release && mkdir -p bin && cp target/release/ascii-diagram bin/ascii-diagram && (mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp target/release/ascii-diagram ~/.local/bin/ascii-diagram 2>/dev/null || echo 'note: skipped ~/.local/bin install')
scripts.sync:pi: mkdir -p ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/benjaminjamesxyz/ascii-diagram-helper/bin ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/benjaminjamesxyz/ascii-diagram-helper/target/release && cp bin/ascii-diagram ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/benjaminjamesxyz/ascii-diagram-helper/bin/ascii-diagram && cp bin/ascii-diagram ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/benjaminjamesxyz/ascii-diagram-helper/target/release/ascii-diagram && cp extensions/ascii-diagram.ts ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/benjaminjamesxyz/ascii-diagram-helper/extensions/ascii-diagram.ts && cp -r skills/. ~/.pi/agent/git/github.com/benjaminjamesxyz/ascii-diagram-helper/skills/ && echo 'synced to installed pi package — reload session to apply'
